mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.dept_id AS deptId, l.check_date AS checkDate, l.user_id AS userId, l.read_time AS readTime, l.create_time AS createTime, u.user_name AS readerName FROM six_check_read_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON l.user_id = u.user_id WHERE l.dept_id = #{deptId} AND l.check_date = #{checkDate} ORDER BY l.read_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO six_check_read_log (dept_id, check_date, user_id, read_time, create_time) VALUES (#{deptId}, #{checkDate}, #{userId}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE read_time = NOW()
